verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform, so operating it with natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack only documents APIs, a point-and-click Dashboard, webhooks, and embeddable UI components. Nothing shows a natural-language, conversational, or AI-assistant interface for operating the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
